mission.requirement_text:
# DORA — article 9(4) : accès, authentification forte, gestion des changements
Source : règlement (UE) 2022/2554, article 9 « Protection and prevention », paragraphe 4. Extraits du texte officiel anglais ; vérifier sur EUR-Lex.

As part of the ICT risk management framework referred to in Article 6(1), financial entities shall:
(c) implement policies that limit the physical or logical access to information assets and ICT assets to what is required for legitimate and approved functions and activities only, and establish to that end a set of policies, procedures and controls that address access rights and ensure a sound administration thereof;
(d) implement policies and protocols for strong authentication mechanisms, based on relevant standards and dedicated control systems, and protection measures of cryptographic keys whereby data is encrypted based on results of approved data classification and ICT risk assessment processes;
(e) implement documented policies, procedures and controls for ICT change management, including changes to software, hardware, firmware components, systems or security parameters, that are based on a risk assessment approach and are an integral part of the financial entity's overall change management process, in order to ensure that all changes to ICT systems are recorded, tested, assessed, approved, implemented and verified in a controlled manner;
(f) have appropriate and comprehensive documented policies for patches and updates.


# RTS 2024/1774 — article 21 : contrôle d'accès
Source : règlement délégué (UE) 2024/1774, article 21 « Access control ». Extraits du texte officiel anglais ; vérifier sur EUR-Lex.

Article 21(1): financial entities shall develop, document, and implement a policy that contains all of the following:
(a) the assignment of access rights to ICT assets based on need-to-know, need-to-use and least privilege principles;
(b) the segregation of duties designed to prevent unjustified access to critical data […];
(c) a provision on user accountability, by limiting to the extent possible the use of generic and shared user accounts;
(d) a provision on restrictions of access to ICT assets, setting out controls and tools to prevent unauthorised access;
(e) account management procedures to grant, change or revoke access rights for user and generic accounts, including:
(ii) assignment of privileged, emergency, and administrator access on a need-to-use or an ad-hoc basis for all ICT systems;
(iv) update of access rights where changes are necessary and at least once a year for all ICT systems […];
(f) authentication methods, including all of the following:
(i) the use of authentication methods commensurate to the classification established […];
(ii) the use of strong authentication methods in accordance with leading practices and techniques for remote access, […] privileged access, for access to ICT assets supporting critical or important functions.


# Politique interne PSI-4 (Banque Kerlann, fictive) — authentification et accès
Déclinaison interne de DORA 9(4)(c)(d) et du RTS 2024/1774 articles 12 et 21 : elle fixe les seuils que les textes ne donnent pas.


Le système KRL-ADM supporte des fonctions critiques ou importantes. La criticité de chaque règle est fixée
par le propriétaire de la politique (RSSI) et s'applique aux constats.

| Règle | Exigence | Criticité | Fondement |
|---|---|---|---|
| PSI-4.1 | Authentification multifacteur obligatoire pour tout compte à privilèges (administrateur). | Critique | DORA 9(4)(d) ; RTS 21(1)(f)(ii) |
| PSI-4.2 | Authentification multifacteur obligatoire pour les utilisateurs d'un système supportant une fonction critique ou importante. | Élevée | DORA 9(4)(d) ; RTS 21(1)(f)(ii) |
| PSI-4.3 | Mot de passe de 12 caractères minimum, avec exigence de complexité. | Moyenne | DORA 9(4)(d) (bonnes pratiques) |
| PSI-4.4 | Verrouillage du compte après 5 échecs de connexion au plus (et jamais désactivé). | Moyenne | DORA 9(4)(c) |
| PSI-4.5 | Expiration des sessions inactives après 15 minutes au plus (et jamais désactivée). | Moyenne | DORA 9(4)(c) |
| PSI-4.6 | Journalisation de toutes les actions d'administration. | Élevée | RTS 12(2)(c)(i) |
| PSI-4.7 | Aucun compte générique ou partagé ne dispose de droits d'administration. Un compte nominatif a un identifiant de la forme `initiale.nom` (ex. `a.lefloch`, nom composé accepté : `m.le-goff`) et une adresse e-mail personnelle, généralement `prenom.nom@` (ex. `anne.lefloch@…`) : l'adresse n'a pas à reproduire l'identifiant. Une boîte partagée (`ops-partage@`, `admin@`…) ou un identifiant de fonction (`ops`, `admin`, `root`…) caractérise un compte générique. | Élevée | DORA 9(4)(c) ; RTS 21(1)(c) et 21(1)(e)(ii) |

## Délais de remédiation (politique interne)
Critique : 30 jours · Élevée : 90 jours · Moyenne : 180 jours · Faible : 365 jours, à compter de la date du rapport.
Toute correction suit le processus de gestion des changements (ticket, approbation, journalisation, vérification).

control.title: Mandatory MFA for privileged administrator accounts
control.objective: Verify MFA is enforced for all privileged admin accounts.
control.test_procedure: GET /api/security verify mfa_admin is true; GET /api/users verify every user with role admin has mfa true.
control.expected: mfa_admin == true and 100% of users with role admin have mfa == true
control.risk: Admin takeover without second factor allows full compromise of critical IAM console.
control.recommendation: Enforce MFA for all admin accounts and re-verify enrollment within 30 days.
control.cause: MFA enforcement disabled or admin account enrolled without MFA.
control.quote: Authentification multifacteur obligatoire pour tout compte à privilèges (administrateur).

before.expected: mfa_admin == true and 100% of users with role admin have mfa == true
before.detail: mfa_admin is False and 0 of 2 admin accounts have mfa true.

inspection.field_text: a.lefloch admin Non; ops admin Non
inspection.comment: Screenshot shows both admin accounts with MFA Non, matching the failed test.

change.rationale: MFA enforcement for privileged accounts is disabled with 0 of 2 admins enrolled, violating PSI-4.1.
change.impact: The 2 admin accounts without MFA will be required to enroll at next login.

after.expected: mfa_admin == true and 100% of users with role admin have mfa == true
after.detail: mfa_admin is True and 2 of 2 admin accounts have mfa true.

inspection.field_text: a.lefloch admin Oui; ops admin Oui
inspection.comment: Screenshot shows two admin accounts both with MFA Oui, matching the automated test result.

control.title: Mandatory MFA for users of critical system
control.objective: Verify MFA is enforced for all users of critical system KRL-ADM.
control.test_procedure: GET /api/security verify mfa_users is true; GET /api/users verify every user has mfa true given KRL-ADM supports critical functions.
control.expected: mfa_users == true and 100% of users have mfa == true
control.risk: Account takeover of standard users on critical system enables lateral movement.
control.recommendation: Enforce MFA for all users and re-verify enrollment within 90 days.
control.cause: MFA enforcement for standard users disabled or users not enrolled.
control.quote: Authentification multifacteur obligatoire pour les utilisateurs d'un système supportant une fonction critique ou importante.

before.expected: mfa_users == true and 100% of users have mfa == true
before.detail: mfa_users is False and 0 of 4 users have mfa true

inspection.field_text: a.lefloch admin Non; ops admin Non; y.morvan conseiller Non; m.quere conseiller Non
inspection.comment: All four user rows show MFA status Non, matching the automated result of 0 of 4 users with MFA.

change.rationale: Enforce mandatory MFA for all standard users on critical system KRL-ADM as required by PSI-4.2.
change.impact: Standard users will be required to enroll in and use MFA at next login.

after.expected: mfa_users == true and 100% of users have mfa == true
after.detail: mfa_users is True and 4 of 4 users have mfa true

inspection.field_text: a.lefloch admin Oui; ops admin Oui; y.morvan conseiller Oui; m.quere conseiller Oui
inspection.comment: Screenshot shows four users all with MFA status Oui.

control.title: Password length and complexity
control.objective: Verify 12-character minimum and complexity are enforced.
control.risk: Weak passwords enable brute-force and credential stuffing.
control.recommendation: Set minimum length to 12 and enable complexity within 180 days.
control.quote: Mot de passe de 12 caractères minimum, avec exigence de complexité.

inspection.field_text: Longueur minimale du mot de passe 6; Complexité du mot de passe exigée Désactivée
inspection.comment: Screenshot shows minimum length 6 and complexity disabled, matching the automated fail result.

change.rationale: Observed policy of 6 characters without complexity violates PSI-4.3 requiring 12 characters minimum with complexity.
change.impact: Users will be required to choose 12-character complex passwords at next creation or reset.

inspection.field_text: Longueur minimale du mot de passe 12 | Complexité du mot de passe exigée Activée
inspection.comment: The screenshot shows minimum length 12 and complexity Activée, matching the automated test result.

control.title: Account lockout after failed logins
control.objective: Verify lockout occurs after at most 5 failures and is enabled.
control.risk: No lockout allows unlimited password guessing.
control.recommendation: Set lockout threshold to 5 or less and never to 0 within 180 days.
control.cause: Lockout disabled or threshold set too high.
control.quote: Verrouillage du compte après 5 échecs de connexion au plus (et jamais désactivé).

before.detail: lockout_threshold is 0, not within 1 to 5 or disabled.

inspection.field_text: Verrouillage après N échecs de connexion Aucun
inspection.comment: The screenshot shows lockout set to Aucun, confirming the automated finding of disabled lockout.

change.rationale: Lockout is disabled with threshold 0, so set it to 5 to meet PSI-4.4 requirement of 1 to 5.
change.impact: Users will be locked out after 5 consecutive failed logins and will require unlock or reset.

after.detail: lockout_threshold is 5, within 1 to 5 and enabled.

inspection.field_text: Verrouillage après N échecs de connexion 5
inspection.comment: The security policy table shows lockout after 5 failed logins, matching the automated test value of 5.

control.title: Inactive session timeout
control.objective: Verify inactive sessions expire after at most 15 minutes.
control.risk: Abandoned sessions allow hijacking on shared workstations.
control.recommendation: Set inactive timeout to 15 minutes or less and never to 0 within 180 days.
control.cause: Session timeout disabled or set too long.
control.quote: Expiration des sessions inactives après 15 minutes au plus (et jamais désactivée).

inspection.comment: The screenshot shows inactive session expiration set to Jamais, confirming the timeout is disabled.

change.rationale: Set inactive session timeout to 15 minutes to satisfy PSI-4.5.
change.impact: Users inactive for 15 minutes will be logged out and must re-authenticate.

inspection.comment: The screenshot shows inactive session expiration set to 15 minutes, matching the test result.

control.title: Logging of administration actions
control.test_procedure: GET /api/security verify admin_audit_log is true; GET /api/journal confirm entries exist.
control.risk: Missing admin logs prevent detection and forensic investigation.
control.recommendation: Enable administration audit logging within 90 days.
control.quote: Journalisation de toutes les actions d'administration.

before.detail: admin_audit_log is True with 0 journal entries.

inspection.comment: The screenshot shows Journalisation des actions d'administration as Activée, matching admin_audit_log true.

actions: Verify via GET /api/security and /admin/security that admin_audit_log remains true.
Investigate journal backend, retention and filtering to explain why GET /api/journal returns 0 entries despite logging being enabled.
Perform one approved administration action and confirm a corresponding entry appears in /admin/journal with ticket, actor and approver.
Escalate to platform team if logging is broken and retain evidence for PSI-4.6 90-day follow-up.
change.rationale: admin_audit_log is already true so an empty journal cannot be fixed by a config toggle and requires human verification.

control.title: No generic shared admin accounts
control.objective: Verify no admin role is held by a generic or shared account.
control.test_procedure: GET /api/users filter role admin; flag login without initiale.nom form (e.g. ops, admin, root) or email with shared box (ops-partage@, admin@).
control.expected: 0 users with role admin having generic login or shared mailbox
control.risk: Shared admin accounts destroy accountability and enable undetected abuse.
control.recommendation: Remove admin rights from generic accounts and replace with nominative initiale.nom accounts within 90 days.
control.cause: Legacy functional admin account retained with admin role.
control.quote: Aucun compte générique ou partagé ne dispose de droits d'administration.

before.expected: 0 users with role admin having generic login or shared mailbox
before.detail: Checked 2 admin accounts and found 1 with generic login or shared mailbox

inspection.comment: The screenshot shows login ops with role admin, confirming the generic admin account flagged by the automated test.

actions: Revoke admin role from generic account login 'ops' (ops-partage@kerlann-banque.example)
Provision nominative firstname.lastname admin accounts for authorized staff requiring privileged access
Verify via GET /api/users and /admin/users that 0 admin accounts have generic login or shared mailbox
change.rationale: Shared admin accounts destroy accountability and enable undetected abuse.

texts: DORA — Article 9(4): access, strong authentication, change management
Internal policy PSI-4 (Banque Kerlann, fictitious) — authentication and access

requirements.quote: implement policies that limit the physical or logical access to information assets and ICT assets to what is required for legitimate and approved functions and activities only, and establish to that end a set of policies, procedures and controls that address access rights and ensure a sound administration thereof;
requirements.summary: Access must be limited to legitimate approved needs with sound access-rights administration.
requirements.why: Testable here through lockout, session and generic-account settings checked by the covering policy controls.

requirements.quote: implement policies and protocols for strong authentication mechanisms, based on relevant standards and dedicated control systems, and protection measures of cryptographic keys whereby data is encrypted based on results of approved data classification and ICT risk assessment processes;
requirements.summary: Strong authentication and key protection must be implemented based on standards and classification.
requirements.why: Testable here through MFA and password settings checked by the covering policy controls.

requirements.quote: implement documented policies, procedures and controls for ICT change management, including changes to software, hardware, firmware components, systems or security parameters, that are based on a risk assessment approach and are an integral part of the financial entity's overall change management process, in order to ensure that all changes to ICT systems are recorded, tested, assessed, approved, implemented and verified in a controlled manner;
requirements.summary: All ICT changes must follow documented risk-based change management with recording and approval.
requirements.why: Not testable here because the read-only interface shows only journal entries, not documented policies for testing and assessment.

requirements.quote: have appropriate and comprehensive documented policies for patches and updates.
requirements.summary: Documented patch and update policies must exist.
requirements.why: Not testable here because the read-only interface exposes no patch policy documents.

requirements.quote: the assignment of access rights to ICT assets based on need-to-know, need-to-use and least privilege principles;
requirements.summary: Access rights must follow need-to-know, need-to-use and least privilege.
requirements.why: Not testable here because the user list shows roles but not the need-to-know justification.

requirements.quote: the segregation of duties designed to prevent unjustified access to critical data […];
requirements.summary: Segregation of duties must prevent unjustified access to critical data.
requirements.why: Not testable here because segregation rules require policy and role-design review beyond the user list.

requirements.quote: a provision on user accountability, by limiting to the extent possible the use of generic and shared user accounts;
requirements.summary: User accountability requires limiting generic and shared accounts.
requirements.why: Testable here through the admin user inventory checked by the covering policy control.

requirements.quote: a provision on restrictions of access to ICT assets, setting out controls and tools to prevent unauthorised access;
requirements.summary: Restrictions and tools must prevent unauthorised access to ICT assets.
requirements.why: Not testable here because the generic provision requires document review of controls and tools.

requirements.quote: account management procedures to grant, change or revoke access rights for user and generic accounts, including:
requirements.summary: Account management procedures must govern granting and revoking access.
requirements.why: Not testable here because procedures require document review beyond the current user list.

requirements.quote: assignment of privileged, emergency, and administrator access on a need-to-use or an ad-hoc basis for all ICT systems;
requirements.summary: Privileged and administrator access must be assigned on need-to-use basis.
requirements.why: Testable here through the admin user inventory checked by the covering policy control.

requirements.quote: update of access rights where changes are necessary and at least once a year for all ICT systems […];
requirements.summary: Access rights must be updated when needed and at least yearly.
requirements.why: Not testable here because the journal shows no access-review periodicity.

requirements.quote: authentication methods, including all of the following:
requirements.summary: Authentication methods policy must cover the listed cases.
requirements.why: Not testable here because the chapeau requires document review of the authentication policy.

requirements.quote: the use of authentication methods commensurate to the classification established […];
requirements.summary: Authentication strength must match data classification.
requirements.why: Not testable here because classification mapping requires document review beyond MFA flags.

requirements.quote: the use of strong authentication methods in accordance with leading practices and techniques for remote access, […] privileged access, for access to ICT assets supporting critical or important functions.
requirements.summary: Strong authentication is required for privileged and critical-function access.
requirements.why: Testable here through MFA enforcement flags and per-user MFA checked by covering controls.

requirements.quote: Authentification multifacteur obligatoire pour tout compte à privilèges (administrateur).
requirements.summary: MFA is mandatory for all privileged administrator accounts.
requirements.why: Testable here because the security API and user list expose MFA enforcement and per-admin MFA status.
